projects.currentVersionStatus: fresh Rust + Flutter rewrite, main at 00adb430efd13b70db8791af3566eae7b4e8aa17 after first implementation commit 3a899b02c27e6abd67d6e92cdf1fe122a52f7b41
projects.maintenanceActivity: repository created and pushed 2026-08-14; predecessor Qt repository pushed 2026-08-13 and explicitly announces migration to Rust
projects.fact: The rewrite splits a Shimeji-compatible runtime into Rust engine/pack/platform/runtime/CLI/store/common crates plus a Flutter manager. It documents QuickJS conditions, 22 actions, native transparent-window backends, .mascot/legacy ZIP handling, HTTP/local IPC compatibility and cargo workspace tests.
projects.fit: PRJ-020 exists to preserve current desktop-pet ecosystem architecture and parity evidence for downstream Mascot/Shimeji/ACS/Petz projects.
projects.benefit: Provides a current side-by-side migration case study with an unusually explicit compatibility contract rather than only a new UI or language rewrite.
projects.integrationCost: low for research and differential fixtures; high for any direct migration
projects.risks: The rewrite is only days old; Linux/macOS visual behavior is not yet real-machine proven and external store/GitHub-App deployment remains pending. It is not the user's canonical mascot source.
projects.migrationPath: Do not replace any canonical project. Run the same resource-pack/action/window/CLI/API corpus against the mature Qt v0.5.3 line and the Rust rewrite, then transplant only measured improvements that preserve existing user-owned engine semantics.
projects.smallestExperiment: Build one Windows differential corpus covering representative Shimeji packs, all encountered action types, .mascot/ZIP import, drag/hit-testing, transparent windows, composition restart and CLI/HTTP/IPC outputs.
projects.acceptance: The candidate is useful only where behavior is parity-proven or a specific measured improvement survives the downstream project's full regression suite. No canonical runtime or research master is replaced.

projects.fact: The recovered Feral base is still React 19.2.7 / Vite 8.1.5 / TypeScript 5.8.3 / Vitest 3.x and its generated release scenarios remain unrun with shippable=false.
projects.fit: The base can be modernized only after its generated Foundry contracts and rollback path are proven in a clean baseline.
projects.benefit: Vite 8.2.2 is a small attributable first toolchain delta; later compiler/test-runner migrations can be measured independently.
projects.integrationCost: low for Vite patch-line trial; medium/high for TypeScript 7 and Vitest 4 migrations
projects.risks: Bundling major compiler/test-runner changes would make failures hard to attribute and could weaken generated validation or ownership semantics.
projects.migrationPath: Baseline first; Vite/plugin pair next; TypeScript 7 separately; Vitest 4 separately; preserve App DNA, semantic events, ownership, promotion, rehearsal, rollback and generated scenarios at every step.
projects.smallestExperiment: Fresh-extract v0.1.0, run every declared Foundry/build/test gate, then trial Vite 8.2.2 with a compatible React plugin and compare generated output plus validation evidence.
projects.acceptance: All prior contracts and output remain available; no generated scenario disappears; rollback still works; shippable status changes only after real gates pass.

projects.currentVersionStatus: Vite 8.2.2; Tauri CLI 2.11.4; Biome 2.5.6; TypeScript 7.0.2; Vitest 4.1.10; Vue stable 3.5.40 with newer 3.6 release-candidate packages
projects.fact: The recovered starter is actually Vue/Tauri but declares tauri-react in blueprint/adapter metadata, floats some dependencies/package-manager versions, and has not run its native release scenarios.
projects.fit: Generator metadata and reproducible dependency resolution are upstream correctness inputs for every downstream portable feature capsule.
projects.benefit: Fixing identity and version determinism before dependency migration prevents future generators from selecting the wrong adapter or silently changing toolchains between clean installs.
projects.risks: A native toolchain update before stack-identity correction can hide generator defects; moving to Vue 3.6 RC would add maturity risk without a demonstrated need.
projects.migrationPath: Correct tauri-react metadata to the verified Vue/Tauri identity, pin floating versions/package manager, prove native baseline, then trial Tauri 2.11.4 and Vite 8.2.2 before isolated TypeScript 7/Vitest 4 migrations.
projects.smallestExperiment: Generate the same starter twice from a clean environment after pinning; require identical manifests/ownership/capsule metadata, then run native Tauri build, Foundry validation/rehearsal/rollback and capsule install-upgrade-remove.
projects.acceptance: Two clean generations are reproducible, stack identity is truthful, native workflow passes, all capsule ownership/rollback evidence survives and no unstable Vue line is adopted without a measured benefit.

projects.fit: The project is explicitly a compatibility pack; another framework/dependency change does not solve its current blocker.
projects.benefit: Avoids version churn and preserves the narrow live-runtime acceptance target.
projects.integrationCost: none until live qualification is available
projects.risks: Changing the stack before the existing matrix is closed would destroy the clean comparison baseline.

projects.acceptance: Plugin-on behavior preserves MO2's native semantic drag result and every project-specific column/data behavior; restart is clean and logs contain no task-related errors.

projects.fact: v8.5 adds first-class TikTok identity/actions/media recovery, per-site enable/disable boot gates, deterministic release packaging and preserves Interaction Capsules, persistent context and the no-culling contract.
projects.fit: This is the canonical user-owned repository and supersedes the Project Constellation wiki's obsolete v8.1/incomplete-v8.2 state.
projects.benefit: Adds a fourth modern feed adapter plus bounded playback recovery while retaining every card and native-backed action.
projects.integrationCost: already present in canonical source; remaining cost is real-browser qualification
projects.risks: TikTok DOM/player behavior is volatile; blob/MSE sources require careful fallback; site boot gates can be misleading if hooks start before settings are checked.
projects.migrationPath: Treat 8.5.0 as the current source line, preserve v7.5/v8.1/v8.3/v8.4 regression evidence, and qualify all four sites in current Chromium/Firefox without culling or reduced fidelity.
projects.smallestExperiment: Exercise TikTok direct-media and blob/MSE cases, native Retry plus bounded fallback, one permanently failing video, and per-site disable/re-enable while measuring retained card counts and native actions.
projects.acceptance: All supported sites retain complete mounted cards; native actions/context persist; disabled sites truly do not boot UltraDeck; TikTok recovery is bounded and targeted; no viewport/card/media cap is introduced.

projectConstellationImprovement.sourceEvidence: ProjectDump commits after the 22:45Z research cursor checkpoint added/changed tracked-project wiki state and scheduled-task supervisor state before this pass began.
projectConstellationImprovement.fit: Project Constellation is now maintained by several recurring jobs; a run can start from a valid cursor while another job has already advanced a project or documentation surface.
projectConstellationImprovement.benefit: A derived delta lens can identify paths changed since the cursor watermark, map them to project IDs/control-plane state, and force re-read of only the affected records before mutation. This reduces duplicate work and stale overwrites without broad connector sweeps.
projectConstellationImprovement.risks: Commit activity alone does not prove semantic authority; user edits and project-owned evidence must still win.
projectConstellationImprovement.migrationPath: Add a read-only intake stage before project selection: compare canonical HEAD to the cursor source checkpoint, classify changed project/control-plane files, and re-read only affected records. Do not auto-edit or auto-rebase project data from the lens.
projectConstellationImprovement.smallestExperiment: Replay the 22:45Z-to-23:15Z ProjectDump delta and verify the lens detects PRJ-020/wiki coverage and Scheduled-Task-Supervisor changes while leaving unrelated 63-project records untouched.
projectConstellationImprovement.acceptance: Every detected delta links to exact commit/path evidence; user edits remain authoritative; no project list changes; no presentation/user state is mutated by the lens; unchanged projects require no extra retrieval.
